payload.text: 0632 DRIVE (hv's order: after 0636; vc: start the drive while 0635 waits). The draft is scratchpad/0632/drive.sh, not banked. It uses the installed binary in a scratch git project under a short HOME, and records each verb's wrote: lines, its git-changed set, and which changed paths got a new or updated file_index row with the file's bytes (record_landed's write, a proxy for the landed list). FIRST RUN: no verb prints a wrote: line. init and lang init and remove are recorded 0 of n; hydrate, dehydrate, renumber and claude upgrade are partial; sync --to-store and agents sync are full. THREE ARMS ARE THE DRIVE'S OWN DEFECTS: the setup wrote an .intentfiles line as 'STEELTHREAD ST0002', not <SIGIL>:<ID>, so organize, sync --to-disk and the issues-add control all refused rc 1. NEXT: fix that setup line and re-run until the control reads recorded; bank the drive on refs/bank/dc/0632/drive.sh; send vc the table. Then the code goes in a worktree with its own target; each cargo run books through vc. 0634 (the Intent.app cask, 3.2.7) follows. No push, no release.
